source_location: Section 4.3, paragraph accompanying Fig. 9(c,d), page 963 A35-18; Section 4.1 defines internal/total error
case: zero-pressure-gradient turbulent boundary layer, after the inflow adjustment
source_statement: The averaged wall stress error is below 0.5% for BFWM and about 2% for EQWM once the effect of the inlet condition is forgotten. Both exhibit comparable total wall-stress errors between 5% and 15% with practical closures.
interpretation: Bounds, approximations and the reported range are preserved as such. No pointwise values are digitised. The range is not a confidence interval or an uncertainty estimate. Internal and total errors come from different outer-closure experiments.
